notes: *and when* is one rendering of the waw of וַיַּרְא under rule 55's coordinator-plus-subordinator sentence, headed on *and*; heading on *when* is the competing reading the corpus takes in a minority of such units. The apodosis waw of וַיָּרֹנּוּ is unrepresented, the ASV writing no connective before *they shouted*.
*saw it* supplies an object with no object morpheme in the clause, so *it* is `added` under rule 44.
מִלִּפְנֵי is split *from* / *before*: the ASV spends *from* on the מִן in particular, which defeats rule 30's one-rendering condition for the whole, while לִפְנֵי still fuses.
The presentative dummy *there* of *there came forth fire* stays with the verb under rules 17 and 21, the explicit subject noun forming its own unit.
